title: Garage contract
description: Language-neutral garage/vehicle shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. vehicle mirrors the Firestore `vehicles/{vehicleId}` document (docs/firebase-data-model.md), which is authenticated-readable by design — registration numbers, VIN, insurance data, and vehicle location are therefore unrepresentable in these schemas and must never be added. Garage features are member-only; each user may have at most 5 vehicles. Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

vehiclePowertrain.description: Powertrain type ACCEPTED on the wire and stored in Firestore (functions/src/garage/garage-core.ts VEHICLE_POWERTRAINS). Clients OFFER only the first four (SELECTABLE_VEHICLE_POWERTRAINS: petrol, diesel, hybrid, electric). `plug_in_hybrid` and `other` are retired: no client offers them, but they are still accepted and stored verbatim so vehicles created before the four-option change are neither corrupted nor dropped, and shipped clients that still send them keep working.

vehicle.description: Firestore `vehicles/{vehicleId}`. Any authenticated user can read; all writes go through the member-only garage.* callables.

modelYear.description: Upper bound is currentYear + 2, validated server-side.

imagePath.description: Cloud Storage path under vehicleImages/{uid}/{vehicleId}/; null until an image is uploaded.

isMainCar.description: True for the caller's single main car (at most one per user, enforced by garage.setMainVehicle). Its photo is shown as the garage header image. Optional: legacy vehicle docs created before this field existed omit it and must be treated as false.

addVehicleRequest.description: Input for garage.addVehicle (member-only; max 5 vehicles per user).

updateVehicleRequest.description: Input for garage.updateVehicle. imagePath must lie under the caller's own vehicleImages/{uid}/{vehicleId}/ prefix (or null to clear).

setMainVehicleRequest.description: Input for garage.setMainVehicle. Sets or clears the caller's main-car flag on one owned vehicle; setting also clears the flag on any other currently-main vehicle (max-1 invariant). Re-affirming the existing state is a write-free no-op.

deleteVehicleRequest.description: Input for garage.deleteVehicle. Removes the vehicleImages/{uid}/{vehicleId}/ storage prefix together with the document.
